'''Brandon Baity''' (YouTube '''NanashiStudios''') is a Portland, Oregon filmmaker and Star Wars CCG player.<ref name="imdb">[https://www.imdb.com/name/nm7363756/ Brandon Baity], IMDb (nm7363756)</ref> He finished '''#47''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 47).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>

On the NanashiStudios channel he posted SWCCG historical video: the unlisted [[DecipherCon 2000]] championship-match interview (footage by [[Derek Brooks]]), ''May The 4th Be With Chuck'' ([[Chuck Kallenbach]], 3 May 2021), a [[Shannon Baksa|Shannon McRandle]] Mara Jade preview (10 December 2021), and the ''2025 SWCCG Worlds Special'' with [[Warren Holland]] (14 June 2026).<ref name="dcon-iv">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ECUW3AIAH3A DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (21 August 2018). Footage by Derek Brooks. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-ECUW3AIAH3A Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="may4">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SuiSGxtUuaY May The 4th Be With Chuck], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (3 May 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-SuiSGxtUuaY Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="mcrandle">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oOX0cT3ukR8 Shannon McRandle (Mara Jade) Preview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (10 December 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-oOX0cT3ukR8 Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="worlds-special">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BuZYhkg35qo 2025 SWCCG Worlds Special], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (14 June 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-BuZYhkg35qo Internet Archive].</ref>

He directed and edited the 2016 fan film [[Turning Point]] (posted 17 July 2017) and launched a GoFundMe on 16 December 2017 for the unreleased documentary [[One With The Force]]. That campaign listed [[Brian Terwilliger]] as co-producer and [[Chris Menzel]] on marketing; it passed a $10,000 goal ($11,069 from 113 donors) and remained paused at 0% complete.<ref name="tp">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00lP1TCpIjw Turning Point - A Star Wars Fan Film], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (17 July 2017). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-00lP1TCpIjw Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="gfm">[https://www.gofundme.com/f/star-wars-ccg-documentary Star Wars CCG Documentary], GoFundMe (Brandon Baity, 16 December 2017)</ref><ref name="owtf">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ALWy-2SwGWM One With The Force Teaser Trailer], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (2 February 2020). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-ALWy-2SwGWM Internet Archive].</ref> The GoFundMe video places his film-school path as Florida, then Hawai'i, then Oregon, and names festival work including Showdown In Chinatown (Honolulu), the Florida Film Festival (Orlando), and 48-Hour Film Festival events in Washington, D.C. and Portland.<ref name="gfm-vid">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S86h_mItIG0 One With The Force GoFundMe Campaign Video], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (16 December 2017). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-S86h_mItIG0 Internet Archive].</ref>
